# Moon 0.4.5 beta
Orbit has a home in Moon.
- Open the full Orbit dashboard in a Moon tab with **See more** or **History → Orbit Activity**. Open it again to return to the same tab. - See website icons in the sidebar summary, dashboard, and activity breakdown. Moon uses its local icon cache, with a letter for sites without an icon. - Switch Orbit sections from the compact menu in narrow windows or Split View.
Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. One signed DMG serves installation and in-app updates. This beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. The optional ActivityWatch companion is distributed separately by its authors.
